nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, $E_n$ is the Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$, the model space carrying the almost complex structure.
nodes.title: Model space $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$ for the Newlander–Nirenberg theorem

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ and let $J$ assign to each point $y \in \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ a real linear map $J(y) : \mathbb{R}^{2n} \to \mathbb{R}^{2n}$. Then $J$ is an almost complex structure on $U$ if $J$ is $C^\infty$ on $U$ and $J(x)(J(x)v) = -v$ for every $x \in U$ and every $v \in \mathbb{R}^{2n}$.
nodes.title: Almost complex structure on a subset of $\mathbb{R}^{2n}$

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ be open and let $J$ be an almost complex structure on $U$ whose Nijenhuis tensor vanishes on $U$. Then every $x \in U$ has holomorphic coordinates for $J$: there are open sets $S \subseteq \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ and $T \subseteq \mathbb{C}^n$ with $x \in S \subseteq U$ and a homeomorphism $\varphi : S \to T$ such that $\varphi$ is $C^\infty$ on $S$,…
nodes.title: Newlander–Nirenberg theorem

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $U \subseteq \mathbb{R}^{2n}$, let $J$ assign to each point $y \in \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ a real linear map $J(y) : \mathbb{R}^{2n} \to \mathbb{R}^{2n}$, and write $N$ for the Nijenhuis tensor of $J$. The Nijenhuis tensor of $J$ vanishes on $U$ if $N(V, W)(x) = 0$ for all $C^\infty$ vector fields $V, W : \mathbb{R}^{2n} \to \mathbb{R}^{2n}$ and every $x \in U$.
nodes.title: Vanishing of the Nijenhuis tensor on a set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
